name: openspec-ui-vscode
description: OpenSpec dashboard, embedded in VS Code as a webview panel.

openspecUI.terminalStartup.description: Command auto-launched when the OpenSpec UI terminal is created (so slash commands land in Claude's REPL). Set to an empty string to disable and stay in the raw shell.

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run prepack:host && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out openspec-ui.vsix
